propositions: Whole-tree build-provenance fixtures export 3,019 checkout files although production hatch_build.py consumes only three files (hatch_build.py, pyproject.toml, src/rebar/__init__.py), causing repeated redundant builds across xdist workers and inflating test runtime.

The _artifact-probe workflow uses GITHUB_SHA instead of deriving the final checked-out HEAD via git rev-parse --short HEAD, allowing it to accept wrong but nonempty trusted-main SHAs on Gerrit patchsets and violating exact-source identity requirements.

Production hatch_build.py on a minimal committed three-file Hatch package preserves exact fallback SHA, env override, Git fallback, blank-env failure, sdist preservation, and shallow-source behaviors while reducing per-worker setup time and focused serial elapsed time.
The artifact-probe must require exact SHA equality for both installed wheel and installed sdist rather than accepting truthiness-only nonempty values.

Minimal fixture reduces xdist per-worker setup from 6.60–6.74s to 2.20–2.88s and focused serial elapsed from 18.23s to 9.11s, demonstrating the fix eliminates redundant initialization and build repetition.
